details: Reycode-baileys@2.0.2 is a WhatsApp Multi-Device library that silently subscribes any account using it to hardcoded WhatsApp channels. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js the socket construction chain (lib/Socket/messages-send.js -> lib/Socket/username.js -> lib/Socket/newsletter.js) arms a setTimeout of 150000 ms; when it fires it loops over four hardcoded newsletter JIDs — 120363421096003443@newsletter, 120363416370859792@newaletter (note the misspelled suffix), 120363431275243639@newsletter and 120363412719371901@newsletter — and sends a w:mex FOLLOW query (query_id 7871414976211147) to each, spacing them 5 seconds apart. No option, configuration flag or user action gates the loop, and it runs on the normal message-send path, so every socket created with the library enrols the authenticated account in those channels. The package also resolves its Signal encryption layer from a third-party repository instead of the official library: dependencies.libsignal is pinned to github:tenka-san/libsignal-node at commit 105ad38dc8d7668b5d5e3688e710915bef5cdc7f, which npm fetches from codeload[.]github[.]com at install time, so the code handling the account's end-to-end key material comes from a non-official source. The preinstall hook engine-requirements.js only checks the Node.js major version. There is no C2 host, IP or credential-exfiltration endpoint in the package; the only network indicators are the WhatsApp channel JIDs above and the tenka-san/libsignal-node repository at that commit. This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp multi-device library with a hidden account-manipulation payload. lib/Socket/newsletter.js hardcodes four WhatsApp newsletter JIDs — 120363421096003443@newsletter, 120363416370859892@newsletter, 120363431275243639@newsletter and 120363412719371901@newsletter — and registers a 150000 ms timer inside the socket module so that, 150 seconds after any socket is created, it iterates the list and sends a wm:mex FOLLOW IQ (newsletterWMexQuery(jid, QueryIds.FOLLOW)) to each channel, pausing 5 seconds between each, then logs "newsletter follow request sent". The follow is unconditional, is not exposed as an option, and cannot be disabled by the integrating application; source comments describe it only in Indonesian ("Auto-follow aktif untuk pengguna library", "ReyCodeDGTL Newsletter"). Any WhatsApp account running a bot built on this library is silently subscribed to channels chosen by the package author. The package also pins its libsignal dependency to a GitHub commit, github:tenka-san/libsignal-node#105ad38dc8d7668b5d5e3688e710915bef5cdc7f, fetched from codeload[.]github[.]com/tenka-san/libsignal-node/tar.gz/105ad38dc8d7668b5d5e3688e710915bef5cdc7f during install; its preinstall script (engine-requirements.js) only checks the Node.js major version.
